# Vendored Unleash OpenFeature Provider

This is the compiled CommonJS distribution of the official
`@unleash/openfeature-node-provider` v1.0.0 release from commit
`39d853027053d81f0882537dadf1bef6b54db4e0`.

The npm tarball published for v1.0.0 omitted its declared `dist/` files. The
lab vendors that immutable release output so fresh installs remain
deterministic. The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included alongside it.
